# QR encoder

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified browser build of [qrcode-generator 2.0.4](https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator), by Kazuhiko Arase, distributed under the MIT license in `qrcode.LICENSE.txt`.

Source archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-2.0.4.tgz (`package/dist/qrcode.js`). Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator.

Only `stickers.html` loads this file. It generates SVG QR codes locally; there is no CDN, QR image service, or runtime package installation.
